AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Harvesting and Storage.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the Kitchen and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer 10 4.3 ICT Support Services 9 Total Numbe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
